id-20260831-news-3.title: House Budget Committee and Government Agree on 2027 State Budget Macro Assumptions, Economy Targeted to Grow up to 6.5 Percent

segments.src: Badan Anggaran (Banggar) DPR RI dan pemerintah akhirnya menuntaskan pembahasan asumsi dasar ekonomi makro dalam Rancangan Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (RAPBN) 2027.
segments.tr: The House of Representatives Budget Committee (Banggar) and the government have finally completed discussions on the macro-economic baseline assumptions in the 2027 State Budget Bill (RAPBN).

segments.src: Kesepakatan ini menjadi salah satu tonggak penting dalam rangkaian pembahasan anggaran negara tahun depan, sebelum masuk ke tahap pembahasan pos-pos belanja dan pendapatan yang lebih rinci.
segments.tr: This agreement marks an important milestone in next year's state budget discussion series, before moving on to more detailed discussions on expenditure and revenue posts.

segments.src: Dalam rapat kerja antara Banggar DPR dan pemerintah, kedua pihak menyepakati target pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional berada pada kisaran 5,8 persen hingga 6,5 persen.
segments.tr: During a working meeting between the House Budget Committee and the government, both parties agreed on a national economic growth target ranging from 5.8 percent to 6.5 percent.

segments.src: Angka ini mencerminkan optimisme terhadap prospek perekonomian domestik, sekaligus menjadi acuan bagi penyusunan target penerimaan negara dan alokasi belanja pada tahun anggaran 2027.
segments.tr: This figure reflects optimism regarding domestic economic prospects, while also serving as a reference for formulating state revenue targets and expenditure allocations for the 2027 fiscal year.

segments.src: ## Inflasi Dijaga di Rentang Terkendali
segments.tr: ## Inflation Maintained Within a Controlled Range

segments.src: Selain pertumbuhan ekonomi, laju inflasi turut menjadi perhatian utama dalam pembahasan asumsi makro tersebut.
segments.tr: In addition to economic growth, the inflation rate is also a primary concern in the discussion of these macro assumptions.

segments.src: Pemerintah dan Banggar DPR sepakat mematok target inflasi pada rentang 1,5 persen hingga 3,5 persen, dengan upaya menjaga agar laju kenaikan harga tetap berada di bawah batas atas 3,5 persen sepanjang tahun anggaran berjalan.
segments.tr: The government and the House Budget Committee agreed to set the inflation target at a range of 1.5 percent to 3.5 percent, with efforts to keep the price increase rate below the upper limit of 3.5 percent throughout the current fiscal year.

segments.src: Target inflasi yang terkendali ini dinilai penting untuk menjaga daya beli masyarakat sekaligus memberikan kepastian bagi dunia usaha dalam merencanakan aktivitas ekonomi.
segments.tr: This controlled inflation target is considered important to maintain people's purchasing power while providing certainty for the business world in planning economic activities.

segments.src: Stabilitas harga barang dan jasa juga menjadi salah satu indikator yang memengaruhi kepercayaan investor terhadap perekonomian nasional.
segments.tr: The price stability of goods and services is also one of the indicators affecting investor confidence in the national economy.

segments.src: ## Fondasi Pembahasan Anggaran Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Foundation for Subsequent Budget Discussions

segments.src: Kesepakatan atas asumsi dasar makro ini akan menjadi fondasi bagi pembahasan lanjutan RAPBN 2027, termasuk penyusunan target penerimaan pajak, belanja negara, hingga defisit anggaran.
segments.tr: This agreement on macro baseline assumptions will serve as the foundation for further discussions of the 2027 State Budget Bill, including the formulation of tax revenue targets, state expenditures, and the budget deficit.

segments.src: Sejumlah indikator lain seperti nilai tukar rupiah, suku bunga surat berharga negara, serta harga dan lifting minyak dan gas bumi juga turut dibahas sebagai bagian dari kerangka ekonomi makro yang lebih menyeluruh.
segments.tr: Several other indicators such as the rupiah exchange rate, state securities interest rates, as well as oil and gas prices and lifting were also discussed as part of a more comprehensive macroeconomic framework.

segments.src: Proses pembahasan ini berlangsung di tengah dinamika ekonomi global yang masih diwarnai berbagai tantangan, mulai dari ketidakpastian rantai pasok, fluktuasi harga komoditas, hingga perubahan arah kebijakan moneter di sejumlah negara besar.
segments.tr: This discussion process took place amidst global economic dynamics still colored by various challenges, ranging from supply chain uncertainties, commodity price fluctuations, to shifting monetary policy directions in several major countries.

segments.src: Pemerintah menekankan pentingnya asumsi makro yang realistis namun tetap mendorong optimisme, agar target pembangunan nasional dapat dicapai tanpa mengabaikan prinsip kehati-hatian fiskal.
segments.tr: The government emphasized the importance of realistic yet optimistic macro assumptions, so that national development targets can be achieved without neglecting fiscal prudence principles.

segments.src: ## Tahapan Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Stages

segments.src: Setelah asumsi dasar makro disepakati, pembahasan RAPBN 2027 akan berlanjut ke tahap pendalaman terhadap rencana kerja dan anggaran masing-masing kementerian dan lembaga.
segments.tr: After the macro baseline assumptions are agreed upon, the 2027 State Budget Bill discussions will proceed to the in-depth stage regarding the work plans and budgets of each ministry and institution.

segments.src: Banggar DPR bersama pemerintah dijadwalkan terus melakukan serangkaian rapat kerja untuk menyelaraskan program prioritas nasional dengan kapasitas fiskal yang tersedia.
segments.tr: The House Budget Committee together with the government are scheduled to continue a series of working meetings to align national priority programs with available fiscal capacity.

segments.src: Kesepakatan awal ini diharapkan dapat mempercepat proses pembahasan anggaran secara keseluruhan, sehingga RAPBN 2027 dapat disahkan tepat waktu sesuai dengan mekanisme dan jadwal yang telah ditetapkan dalam siklus penganggaran nasional.
segments.tr: This initial agreement is expected to accelerate the overall budget discussion process, so that the 2027 State Budget Bill can be ratified on time in accordance with the mechanism and schedule set in the national budgeting cycle.

segments.src: Publik dan pelaku usaha turut menantikan kepastian arah kebijakan fiskal tahun depan, mengingat asumsi makro ini akan berdampak langsung pada berbagai sektor perekonomian, mulai dari investasi, ketenagakerjaan, hingga daya beli masyarakat secara luas.
segments.tr: The public and business actors are also looking forward to certainty regarding next year's fiscal policy direction, considering that these macro assumptions will directly impact various economic sectors, ranging from investment, employment, to broad public purchasing power.

id-20260831-news-1.title: BMKG Issues Early Warning for Extreme Weather on August 31, 2026, 15 Provinces Urged to Be Alert for Heavy Rain and Strong Winds

segments.src: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG) mengeluarkan peringatan dini terkait potensi cuaca ekstrem yang berlaku pada Senin, 31 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) has issued an early warning regarding the potential for extreme weather effective on Monday, August 31, 2026.

segments.src: Dalam keterangan resminya, BMKG menyebutkan bahwa sejumlah wilayah di Indonesia berpotensi mengalami hujan dengan intensitas lebat disertai kilat/petir dan angin kencang, sehingga masyarakat diimbau untuk meningkatkan kewaspadaan terhadap dampak cuaca hidrometeorologi.
segments.tr: In its official statement, BMKG mentioned that a number of regions in Indonesia have the potential to experience heavy rainfall accompanied by lightning/thunderstorms and strong winds, so the public is urged to increase vigilance against the impacts of hydrometeorological weather.

segments.src: ## Wilayah yang Perlu Diwaspadai
segments.tr: ## Regions That Need to Be Alert

segments.src: Berdasarkan analisis dinamika atmosfer terkini, BMKG memperkirakan potensi hujan lebat dapat terjadi di sebagian wilayah Sumatra, Sulawesi, Maluku, dan Papua.
segments.tr: Based on the latest atmospheric dynamics analysis, BMKG estimates that the potential for heavy rain may occur in parts of Sumatra, Sulawesi, Maluku, and Papua.

segments.src: Selain potensi hujan deras, sejumlah provinsi lain juga diperkirakan menghadapi risiko angin kencang yang dapat berdampak pada aktivitas masyarakat, terutama di wilayah pesisir dan dataran terbuka.
segments.tr: In addition to the potential for heavy rain, a number of other provinces are also expected to face the risk of strong winds that could impact public activities, especially in coastal areas and open plains.

segments.src: Secara total, BMKG mencatat sekitar 15 provinsi masuk dalam kategori waspada terkait potensi cuaca signifikan ini.
segments.tr: In total, BMKG notes that around 15 provinces are in the alert category regarding this potential for significant weather.

segments.src: Kondisi tersebut dipengaruhi oleh sejumlah faktor atmosfer, termasuk aktivitas gelombang tropis, pola angin di wilayah ekuator, serta labilitas udara lokal yang mendukung pertumbuhan awan hujan secara cepat.
segments.tr: This condition is influenced by a number of atmospheric factors, including tropical wave activity, wind patterns in the equatorial region, and local air instability that supports the rapid growth of rain clouds.

segments.src: ## Potensi Dampak yang Perlu Diantisipasi
segments.tr: ## Potential Impacts to Anticipate

segments.src: BMKG mengingatkan bahwa hujan dengan intensitas lebat dalam durasi singkat berpotensi memicu sejumlah dampak ikutan, di antaranya:
segments.tr: BMKG warns that heavy intensity rain in a short duration has the potential to trigger a number of follow-up impacts, including:

segments.src: - **Genangan dan banjir** di kawasan permukiman dataran rendah maupun perkotaan dengan sistem drainase terbatas.
segments.tr: - **Inundation and flooding** in low-lying residential areas or urban areas with limited drainage systems.

segments.src: - **Luapan sungai** pada daerah aliran sungai yang menerima curah hujan tinggi di wilayah hulu.
segments.tr: - **River overflow** in river basins that receive high rainfall in upstream areas.

segments.src: - **Tanah longsor**, khususnya di wilayah perbukitan, lereng curam, atau area dengan kondisi tanah yang labil.
segments.tr: - **Landslides**, especially in hilly areas, steep slopes, or areas with unstable soil conditions.

segments.src: - **Gangguan aktivitas luar ruangan** akibat angin kencang, termasuk potensi pohon tumbang dan gangguan pada bangunan semi permanen.
segments.tr: - **Disruption of outdoor activities** due to strong winds, including the potential for fallen trees and damage to semi-permanent buildings.

segments.src: Dampak-dampak tersebut bersifat potensi dan tingkat keparahannya dapat berbeda-beda di setiap daerah, tergantung kondisi geografis dan infrastruktur setempat.
segments.tr: These impacts are potential and their severity may vary in each region, depending on local geographical conditions and infrastructure.

segments.src: ## Imbauan BMKG untuk Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## BMKG's Appeal to the Public

segments.src: Menyikapi kondisi ini, BMKG mengimbau masyarakat di wilayah yang berpotensi terdampak untuk melakukan sejumlah langkah antisipasi, antara lain:
segments.tr: Responding to this condition, BMKG urges the public in potentially affected areas to take a number of anticipatory steps, including:

segments.src: 1. Memantau informasi cuaca terbaru secara berkala melalui kanal resmi BMKG, baik situs web maupun aplikasi resmi.
segments.tr: 1. Monitoring the latest weather information periodically through official BMKG channels, both the website and the official application.

segments.src: 2. Membersihkan saluran air di lingkungan rumah agar tidak tersumbat guna mengurangi risiko genangan.
segments.tr: 2. Cleaning water channels in the home environment so they are not clogged to reduce the risk of inundation.

segments.src: 3. Menghindari aktivitas di bawah pohon besar, papan reklame, atau bangunan yang berpotensi roboh saat angin kencang berlangsung.
segments.tr: 3. Avoiding activities under large trees, billboards, or buildings that have the potential to collapse when strong winds occur.

segments.src: 4. Bagi warga di wilayah rawan longsor, disarankan untuk tetap waspada terhadap tanda-tanda awal seperti retakan tanah atau munculnya mata air baru di lereng.
segments.tr: 4. For residents in landslide-prone areas, it is advised to remain alert to early signs such as soil cracks or the appearance of new springs on slopes.

segments.src: 5. Menyiapkan jalur evakuasi mandiri serta mengikuti arahan dari pemerintah daerah maupun petugas penanggulangan bencana setempat apabila diperlukan.
segments.tr: 5. Preparing independent evacuation routes and following directions from local governments or local disaster management officers if necessary.

segments.src: ## Pentingnya Kesiapsiagaan Dini
segments.tr: ## The Importance of Early Preparedness

segments.src: Cuaca ekstrem yang bersifat musiman maupun dipicu fenomena atmosfer jangka pendek memang sulit dihindari sepenuhnya, namun dampaknya dapat diminimalkan melalui kesiapsiagaan yang baik.
segments.tr: Extreme weather that is seasonal or triggered by short-term atmospheric phenomena is indeed difficult to avoid completely, but its impact can be minimized through good preparedness.

segments.src: BMKG secara rutin memperbarui prakiraan cuaca setiap harinya, sehingga masyarakat disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan informasi resmi guna mengambil langkah antisipasi yang tepat.
segments.tr: BMKG routinely updates the weather forecast every day, so the public is advised to continue monitoring the development of official information in order to take appropriate anticipatory steps.

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah bersama instansi terkait seperti Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) juga diharapkan dapat menindaklanjuti peringatan dini ini dengan koordinasi kesiapsiagaan di tingkat lokal, termasuk penyiapan posko maupun jalur evakuasi di daerah yang secara historis rawan bencana hidrometeorologi.
segments.tr: Local governments together with related agencies such as the Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD) are also expected to follow up on this early warning with preparedness coordination at the local level, including the preparation of command posts and evacuation routes in areas that are historically prone to hydrometeorological disasters.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk tidak mudah terpengaruh oleh informasi yang belum terverifikasi terkait cuaca maupun bencana, dan senantiasa merujuk pada sumber resmi seperti BMKG serta instansi pemerintah terkait untuk mendapatkan informasi yang akurat dan terkini.
segments.tr: The public is urged not to be easily influenced by unverified information regarding weather or disasters, and to always refer to official sources such as BMKG and related government agencies to get accurate and up-to-date information.

id-20260831-news-2.title: Indonesia's Trade Balance Surplus Shrinks 81.75% to US$3.58 Billion, A Signal to Watch Ahead of Late August 2026

segments.src: ## Surplus Menipis, Sinyal Waspada Muncul
segments.tr: ## Shrinking Surplus, A Warning Signal Emerges

segments.src: Neraca perdagangan Indonesia sepanjang tahun berjalan tercatat mengalami penyusutan tajam.
segments.tr: Indonesia's trade balance throughout the year has experienced a sharp contraction.

segments.src: Surplus yang terkumpul hanya mencapai sekitar US$3,58 miliar, anjlok hingga 81,75% dibandingkan capaian pada periode yang sama tahun lalu.
segments.tr: The accumulated surplus only reached around US$3.58 billion, plunging by up to 81.75% compared to the achievement in the same period last year.

segments.src: Penurunan sedalam ini menjadi salah satu indikator yang mulai menyita perhatian para pengamat ekonomi, terutama karena muncul bersamaan dengan pelemahan di sektor penjualan eceran dan tekanan yang dirasakan di pasar tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: A decline this deep has become one of the indicators starting to draw the attention of economic observers, especially because it coincides with a weakening in the retail sales sector and pressures felt in the labor market.

segments.src: Meski neraca perdagangan masih berada di zona positif alias surplus, laju penyusutannya yang signifikan menjadi catatan penting.
segments.tr: Although the trade balance remains in positive territory alias a surplus, the pace of its significant contraction serves as an important note.

segments.src: Sebab, surplus perdagangan selama ini menjadi salah satu penopang utama stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah dan cadangan devisa nasional.
segments.tr: This is because the trade surplus has long been one of the main pillars supporting the stability of the rupiah exchange rate and national foreign exchange reserves.

segments.src: ## Faktor di Balik Penyusutan Surplus
segments.tr: ## Factors Behind the Surplus Contraction

segments.src: Beberapa faktor umum yang biasa memengaruhi pelebaran atau penyempitan neraca dagang antara lain adalah pergerakan harga komoditas ekspor andalan, permintaan dari mitra dagang utama, serta kebutuhan impor bahan baku dan barang modal untuk mendukung aktivitas industri dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Some common factors that usually influence the widening or narrowing of the trade balance include the price movements of mainstay export commodities, demand from major trading partners, as well as the need for imports of raw materials and capital goods to support domestic industrial activities.

segments.src: Ketika ekspor melambat sementara impor relatif bertahan atau justru meningkat, surplus pun otomatis tergerus.
segments.tr: When exports slow down while imports remain relatively stable or even increase, the surplus is automatically eroded.

segments.src: Kondisi ini turut diperparah oleh sinyal pelemahan konsumsi domestik yang tecermin dari data penjualan eceran yang belum sepenuhnya pulih.
segments.tr: This condition is further exacerbated by signals of weakening domestic consumption reflected in retail sales data that have not fully recovered.

segments.src: Penjualan eceran merupakan salah satu proksi penting untuk mengukur daya beli masyarakat, sehingga pelemahannya sering dibaca sebagai indikasi bahwa konsumen mulai lebih berhati-hati dalam membelanjakan pendapatannya.
segments.tr: Retail sales are one of the important proxies for measuring public purchasing power, so their weakening is often read as an indication that consumers are starting to be more cautious in spending their income.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, tekanan di pasar kerja juga menjadi variabel yang tidak bisa diabaikan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, pressure in the labor market is also a variable that cannot be ignored.

segments.src: Ketika penyerapan tenaga kerja melambat atau terjadi efisiensi di sejumlah sektor usaha, daya beli masyarakat berpotensi ikut tertekan, yang pada akhirnya dapat memengaruhi konsumsi rumah tangga sebagai salah satu motor utama pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: When labor absorption slows down or efficiency occurs in a number of business sectors, public purchasing power has the potential to also come under pressure, which in turn can affect household consumption as one of the main engines of national economic growth.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Data Ini Penting Diperhatikan
segments.tr: ## Why This Data Is Important to Pay Attention To

segments.src: Kombinasi antara menyusutnya surplus dagang, lesunya penjualan eceran, dan tekanan di pasar kerja membentuk rangkaian indikator yang saling berkaitan.
segments.tr: The combination of a shrinking trade surplus, sluggish retail sales, and pressure in the labor market forms a series of interrelated indicators.

segments.src: Ketiganya kerap dijadikan rujukan oleh otoritas moneter dan fiskal untuk menilai arah kebijakan ke depan, termasuk dalam mempertimbangkan langkah-langkah menjaga stabilitas ekonomi menjelang penutupan kuartal ketiga 2026.
segments.tr: All three are often used as a reference by monetary and fiscal authorities to assess the direction of future policies, including in considering steps to maintain economic stability ahead of the close of the third quarter of 2026.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha maupun masyarakat umum, perkembangan ini menjadi pengingat pentingnya memantau data ekonomi secara berkala.
segments.tr: For business actors and the general public, this development serves as an important reminder to monitor economic data periodically.

segments.src: Pelemahan pada beberapa indikator sekaligus biasanya mendorong pemerintah dan bank sentral untuk lebih cermat dalam merumuskan kebijakan, baik dari sisi perdagangan, dukungan terhadap sektor konsumsi, maupun stabilitas pasar tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: A weakening in several indicators simultaneously usually prompts the government and the central bank to be more careful in formulating policies, both from the trade side, support for the consumption sector, and labor market stability.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dicermati ke Depan
segments.tr: ## What to Watch Ahead

segments.src: Pemerintah dan otoritas terkait diperkirakan akan terus memantau perkembangan neraca dagang dalam beberapa bulan mendatang, khususnya menjelang penyusunan proyeksi pertumbuhan ekonomi semester kedua.
segments.tr: The government and related authorities are expected to continue monitoring the development of the trade balance in the coming months, especially ahead of the formulation of second-semester economic growth projections.

segments.src: Sejumlah langkah yang lazim ditempuh dalam situasi semacam ini antara lain mendorong diversifikasi pasar ekspor, memperkuat daya saing produk dalam negeri, serta menjaga daya beli masyarakat melalui berbagai program stimulus.
segments.tr: A number of steps commonly taken in such situations include encouraging export market diversification, strengthening the competitiveness of domestic products, and maintaining public purchasing power through various stimulus programs.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, memahami dinamika neraca perdagangan dapat membantu membaca arah kondisi ekonomi secara lebih luas, mulai dari potensi pergerakan nilai tukar hingga prospek harga barang kebutuhan sehari-hari.
segments.tr: For the public, understanding the dynamics of the trade balance can help read the direction of broader economic conditions, ranging from potential exchange rate movements to the prospects of daily necessity prices.

segments.src: Meski demikian, penting untuk tetap merujuk pada data resmi dari lembaga seperti Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) dan Bank Indonesia guna mendapatkan gambaran yang paling akurat dan terkini seiring berjalannya waktu.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, it is important to continue referring to official data from institutions such as the Central Statistics Agency (BPS) and Bank Indonesia to obtain the most accurate and up-to-date picture as time goes on.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan gambaran umum perkembangan ekonomi dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai saran investasi atau keuangan.
segments.tr: *This article is compiled based on a general overview of economic developments and is not intended as investment or financial advice.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan untuk merujuk pada sumber data resmi sebelum mengambil keputusan ekonomi maupun bisnis.*
segments.tr: Readers are advised to refer to official data sources before making economic or business decisions.*

id-20260831-intro-agriculture-12.title: [Agronomy #12] The Silent War in the Rice Field: Managing Pests and Weeds Without Losing

segments.src: > Hama dan gulma bukan musuh yang harus dibasmi habis, melainkan populasi yang harus dijaga tetap di bawah ambang kerugian ekonomi.
segments.tr: > Pests and weeds are not enemies that must be completely eradicated, but rather populations that must be kept below the economic injury threshold.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Setiap tanaman yang kita tanam sebenarnya sedang bersaing dan berjuang.
segments.tr: Every plant we grow is actually competing and struggling.

segments.src: Ada dua "penantang" utama di lapangan.
segments.tr: There are two main "challengers" in the field.

segments.src: **Hama** adalah organisme (paling sering serangga, tetapi bisa juga tungau, siput, atau tikus) yang merusak tanaman dengan cara memakan daun, mengisap cairan, mengebor batang, atau menularkan penyakit.
segments.tr: **Pests** are organisms (most often insects, but can also be mites, snails, or rats) that damage plants by eating leaves, sucking sap, boring into stems, or transmitting diseases.

segments.src: **Gulma** adalah tumbuhan yang tumbuh di tempat yang tidak kita inginkan, lalu berebut sinar matahari, air, dan unsur hara dengan tanaman utama kita.
segments.tr: **Weeds** are plants that grow where we do not want them, then compete for sunlight, water, and nutrients with our main crops.

segments.src: Kesalahpahaman terbesar petani pemula adalah berpikir tujuan kita membunuh semua hama sampai nol.
segments.tr: The biggest misconception for beginner farmers is thinking our goal is to kill all pests down to zero.

segments.src: Itu tidak realistis dan sering merugikan.
segments.tr: That is unrealistic and often counterproductive.

segments.src: Ilmu agronomi memperkenalkan konsep **ambang kerugian ekonomi** (economic threshold): titik di mana kepadatan hama sudah cukup tinggi sehingga biaya pengendalian menjadi lebih murah daripada nilai panen yang hilang.
segments.tr: Agronomy introduces the concept of the **economic threshold**: the point where pest density is high enough that the cost of control becomes cheaper than the value of the lost harvest.

segments.src: Selama populasi hama masih di bawah titik itu, membiarkannya justru lebih bijak, karena musuh alami dapat menekannya secara gratis.
segments.tr: As long as the pest population is still below that point, leaving them alone is actually wiser, because natural enemies can suppress them for free.

segments.src: Untuk itulah dikenal pendekatan **PHT (Pengendalian Hama Terpadu)** atau Integrated Pest Management.
segments.tr: That is why the **IPM (Integrated Pest Management)** approach is known.

segments.src: Prinsipnya: gabungkan beberapa cara sekaligus, dan jadikan pestisida kimia sebagai pilihan terakhir, bukan yang pertama.
segments.tr: The principle: combine several methods at once, and make chemical pesticides the last resort, not the first.

segments.src: Empat pilar utamanya:
segments.tr: Its four main pillars:

segments.src: 1. **Pengendalian budidaya** — rotasi tanaman, pengaturan waktu tanam, sanitasi lahan agar hama tidak betah.
segments.tr: 1. **Cultural control** — crop rotation, planting time adjustment, land sanitation so pests do not feel at home.

segments.src: 2. **Pengendalian hayati** — memanfaatkan **musuh alami** (predator, parasitoid) untuk menekan hama.
segments.tr: 2. **Biological control** — utilizing **natural enemies** (predators, parasitoids) to suppress pests.

segments.src: 3. **Pengendalian mekanis/fisik** — mencabut gulma, memasang perangkap, memakai mulsa.
segments.tr: 3. **Mechanical/physical control** — pulling weeds, setting traps, using mulch.

segments.src: 4. **Pengendalian kimia** — pestisida atau herbisida secara selektif dan terukur.
segments.tr: 4. **Chemical control** — pesticides or herbicides selectively and measuredly.

segments.src: Untuk gulma, kunci utamanya adalah **periode kritis**: rentang waktu (biasanya beberapa minggu awal pertumbuhan) ketika tanaman paling rentan kalah bersaing.
segments.tr: For weeds, the main key is the **critical period**: the time range (usually the first few weeks of growth) when plants are most vulnerable to losing the competition.

segments.src: Bersihkan gulma pada periode ini, dan sisa musim jadi jauh lebih ringan.
segments.tr: Clear the weeds during this period, and the rest of the season becomes much easier.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Pak Slamet, petani padi di Klaten, Jawa Tengah.
segments.tr: Imagine Mr. Slamet, a rice farmer in Klaten, Central Java.

segments.src: Musim lalu ia panik melihat wereng cokelat dan langsung menyemprot insektisida keras berkali-kali.
segments.tr: Last season he panicked seeing brown planthoppers and immediately sprayed harsh insecticides multiple times.

segments.src: Hasilnya?
segments.tr: The result?

segments.src: Wereng malah meledak lagi, karena semprotannya juga membunuh laba-laba dan capung yang selama ini memangsa wereng.
segments.tr: The planthoppers exploded again, because the spray also killed the spiders and dragonflies that had been preying on the planthoppers.

segments.src: Ia habis Rp 800.000 untuk pestisida, tapi panennya tetap turun.
segments.tr: He spent Rp 800,000 on pesticides, but his harvest still decreased.

segments.src: Musim ini ia mengubah strategi dengan pendekatan PHT.
segments.tr: This season he changed his strategy with the IPM approach.

segments.src: Ia mulai dengan **jajar legowo** agar sinar matahari masuk dan hama lembap berkurang, menanam bunga di pematang untuk mengundang serangga predator, lalu memantau petak sawahnya seminggu sekali.
segments.tr: He started with **jajar legowo** (row planting) so sunlight enters and pest humidity decreases, planting flowers on the bunds to invite predatory insects, then monitoring his rice plots once a week.

segments.src: Ketika ditemukan wereng, ia menghitung dulu: hanya sekitar 3 ekor per rumpun, masih di bawah ambang.
segments.tr: When planthoppers were found, he calculated first: only about 3 per clump, still below the threshold.

segments.src: Ia menahan diri.
segments.tr: He held back.

segments.src: Untuk gulma, ia fokus menyiang pada 3-4 minggu pertama setelah tanam, saat padi paling butuh ruang.
segments.tr: For weeds, he focused on weeding in the first 3-4 weeks after planting, when rice needs space the most.

segments.src: Hasilnya, biaya pestisida turun drastis, laba-laba kembali bekerja gratis, dan gabahnya lebih penuh.
segments.tr: The result, pesticide costs dropped drastically, spiders returned to work for free, and his grain was fuller.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: - Hama dan gulma dikelola, bukan diberantas total; patokannya adalah ambang kerugian ekonomi.
segments.tr: - Pests and weeds are managed, not totally eradicated; the benchmark is the economic injury threshold.

segments.src: - PHT menggabungkan cara budidaya, hayati, mekanis, dan kimia — dengan kimia sebagai jurus terakhir.
segments.tr: - IPM combines cultural, biological, mechanical, and chemical methods — with chemicals as the last resort.

segments.src: - Musuh alami dan penyiangan pada periode kritis adalah senjata murah yang sering terlupakan.
segments.tr: - Natural enemies and weeding during the critical period are cheap weapons that are often forgotten.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: 1. Apa arti "ambang kerugian ekonomi" dalam pengendalian hama?
segments.tr: 1. What is the meaning of "economic injury threshold" in pest control?

segments.src: a) Batas anggaran pestisida per musim
segments.tr: a) Pesticide budget limit per season

segments.src: b) Kepadatan hama saat biaya pengendalian mulai lebih murah daripada nilai panen yang hilang
segments.tr: b) Pest density when control costs start to be cheaper than the value of the lost harvest

segments.src: c) Jumlah maksimum panen yang boleh dijual
segments.tr: c) Maximum amount of harvest that can be sold

segments.src: 2. (O/X) Dalam PHT, pestisida kimia sebaiknya menjadi langkah pertama yang diambil petani.
segments.tr: 2. (T/F) In IPM, chemical pesticides should be the first step taken by farmers.

segments.src: 3. Manakah yang termasuk pengendalian hayati?
segments.tr: 3. Which of the following is included in biological control?

segments.src: a) Menyemprot herbisida ke gulma
segments.tr: a) Spraying herbicide on weeds

segments.src: b) Melepas atau menjaga predator alami seperti laba-laba untuk memangsa hama
segments.tr: b) Releasing or maintaining natural predators like spiders to prey on pests

segments.src: c) Memasang plastik mulsa
segments.tr: c) Installing plastic mulch

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terminology of the Day

segments.src: - **Hama**: Organisme (sering serangga) yang merusak tanaman budidaya.
segments.tr: - **Pest**: Organisms (often insects) that damage cultivated plants.

segments.src: - **Gulma**: Tumbuhan yang tumbuh tidak dikehendaki dan bersaing dengan tanaman utama.
segments.tr: - **Weed**: Plants that grow unwanted and compete with main crops.

segments.src: - **PHT (Pengendalian Hama Terpadu)**: Strategi memadukan beberapa metode pengendalian, dengan kimia sebagai pilihan terakhir.
segments.tr: - **IPM (Integrated Pest Management)**: A strategy of combining several control methods, with chemicals as the last option.

segments.src: - **Musuh alami**: Predator atau parasitoid yang secara alami menekan populasi hama.
segments.tr: - **Natural enemy**: Predators or parasitoids that naturally suppress pest populations.

segments.src: - **Periode kritis gulma**: Rentang waktu awal saat tanaman paling rentan kalah bersaing melawan gulma.
segments.tr: - **Critical weed period**: The initial time range when plants are most vulnerable to losing competition against weeds.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1-b (ambang kerugian ekonomi adalah titik saat biaya kendali setara/lebih murah daripada kerugian panen); 2-X (justru salah — kimia adalah jurus terakhir setelah cara budidaya, hayati, dan mekanis); 3-b (memanfaatkan predator alami adalah inti pengendalian hayati, sedangkan herbisida dan mulsa termasuk pengendalian kimia dan mekanis).*
segments.tr: *Answers: 1-b (economic injury threshold is the point where control costs are equal to/cheaper than harvest losses); 2-F (actually wrong — chemicals are the last resort after cultural, biological, and mechanical methods); 3-b (utilizing natural predators is the core of biological control, while herbicides and mulch are included in chemical and mechanical control).*
